args.title: Fix currency symbol handling in transaction amounts
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts

Update the SQL query logic to correctly ignore prefixed currency symbols such as ₹ when extracting amount values. This will prevent errors relating to 'The amount is not a number'.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The SQL query for extracting amounts in transactionRepo.ts does not account for prefixed currency symbols, leading to 'The amount is not a number' error when symbols like ₹ are present.
